REASON: I chose Dunlin because the query is a benign, general-knowledge explanatory task with no harm-adjacent content that would make Lapwing's moderation-tolerance profile relevant. With cost, latency, and context window identical across the fleet, capability is the deciding factor — and Dunlin leads on every relevant metric (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 74.8, IFEval 89.8 vs 85.6, Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 81.4, plus higher internal Creative/Summarization/Extraction scores). So it's simply the stronger model for a task where nothing else differentiates them.
